doc: The states, provinces and territories a license can be issued by.
The vehicle makes. Reached only through the vehicle make list definition, which imports this module
dynamically, so it is fetched when a make select first needs it rather than when the form loads.
The vehicle models, each carrying the value of the make it belongs to. Reached only through the vehicle
model list definition, which imports this module dynamically, so it is fetched once a make has been
chosen and its models are needed.
